source_text.body:
Shop and plan travel with an agent that checks in over Slack
A reviewer used Dots as a personal shopper that asked questions over Slack, and to compare Airbnbs and hotels, though admin sites often blocked its browser.
Done with
DO
Dots
What they did
Pat Simmons connected his dot, named László, to Gmail, his Mac and Slack. He gave it a shopping list and a Montreal trip. For shopping, it posted screenshots and asked about colors in Slack. For the trip, it browsed Airbnb and Air Canada, compared hotels, picked a direct flight and built an itinerary.
How it went
Amazon blocked its browser, so shopping fell back to Chrome on his computer and he judged it not ready. Travel worked well. It stopped at checkout, so he paid himself.
Worth knowing
The dot comes only with the Pro plan, which starts at $100 a month, and many admin sites may block its cloud browser.
Try it yourself
with
Dots
Copy prompt
Act as my personal shopper and travel planner. For shopping, find [item] under [budget] and check in with me over [Slack] whenever a choice depends on my taste. For travel, compare Airbnbs and hotels in [destination] for [dates] and [number of guests], and give me a shortlist of 3 options with price, location, cancellation terms, and links. If a site blocks your browser, tell me what you couldn't access, and do not book or pay for anything without showing me the details first.
Original source: https://www.aiformortals.co/blog/openai-dots
